company.name: PostHog
company.shortDescription: PostHog is an open source platform that helps build successful products by providing tools to evaluate feature impact and customer value.
company.description: PostHog provides an open‑source platform for product analytics, combining tools such as event tracking, session replay, surveys, error monitoring, and feature flag management into a unified system. It enables teams to deploy feature flags with multivariate options, scheduled releases, early access control, and cross‑project syncing, while integrating playback and analytics for testing and rollout validation. The platform supports running A/B experiments, collecting qualitative feedback via surveys, and tracking errors alongside data pipelines and data warehouse connectors. It also offers lightweight AI-powered assistance and observability features tailored to product and development workflows. This toolkit is organized under a cohesive product OS that emphasizes open development practices, transparency of roadmap, and community contributions.
